page.overview:
Who is Duvia Dwendal?

Queen Duvia Dwendal was a noblewoman of the Dwendalian Empire, and the consort of its ruler, King Bertrand Dwendal, until her death.

Duvia was a human woman who kept her husband company while she was alive.

Duvia was a noble of the Dwendalian Empire who, when she reached an appropriate age, married Bertrand Dwendal, who became ruler of the Empire in 790 PD. Together, the couple had at least one son, Prince Eidys Dwendal, who became his father's heir. Queen Duvia died around 826 PD, following which the king became a lonely man, and had not married again, through at least 835 PD.
